messages:
elaine: Heads-up 1 opened a docs PR to add Hong Kong + Seoul to the Regions & Data Residency page and included a short migration checklist for Dedicated. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/950
sam: Thanks. Legal asked we avoid the phrase 'data residency guarantee'. Use 'data processed and stored in the selected region unless specific cross-region features are enabled' instead. Can you include a link to the compliance page?
elainE: small typo in my last msg ^^ meant 'elaine' :) Updated PR copy with the suggested sentence and added compliance link.
matt: I'll add SDK examples for region selection. Planning to show both the Python client and the CLI snippet for migrations. Will include a note about KMS key scoping across regions.
luis: Make sure the table shows availability matrix for Hosted / Dedicated / Private separately. Private availability is "by arrangement" for some APAC locations; add a footnote.
nisha: I'll review legal phrasing now. Quick point: prefer 'data processing region' term. Also request we surface export-control disclaimer for certain regions.
elainE: addressed the 'data processing region' wording in the intro paragraph. Also added an export-control callout under the footnotes.
sam: Can we add a small troubleshooting section: "If you're seeing region mismatch errors" with the console screenshot and the common fix (update project region in console and re-issue keys)?
matt: added screenshot link and a code comment in the Python example showing region param and kms_key. Sample: ```python
client = RedwoodClient(region="asia-east2", kms_key="projects/proj/locations/asia-east2/keyR")
```
docs-bot: PR #950 preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/regions/availability-950 1 build passed, link generated.
elaine: Quick QA ask: someone scan staging page for any hard claims that data "never leaves" a region. Legal will object.
nisha: skimmed staging; left two inline comments to soften language. Also suggested the migration checklist include expected downtime window "~15-60 mins" rather than absolute times.
luis: added the footnote for Private/on-prem packages linking to the Private deployment matrix doc. Also added a line about contacting solutions engineering for custom region work.
sam: once legal thumbs up, can we add a 1-line note to the weekly docs digest about the new regions and migration checklist? PMs should be aware.
elaine: will merge after Nisha +1. thanks everyone!
docs-bot: Merge readiness: CI: docs build 705. Open comments: 2 (legal wording addressed). No conflicts.
matt: FYI pushed a small follow-up commit that clarifies KMS cross-region behavior and adds TypeScript snippet.
elaine: merging now after Nisha confirmed. will add changelog entry to the weekly digest. :white_check_mark:
